contexts.text: The sons of the one relate to the class of spiritual things, and the sons of the other to the class of celestial things.
They referred into classes all the goods which are of charity towards the neighbour. Enumerated. AC 4302:3. AC 4844:3. AC 4955:2. AC 6004:2. AC 6705, Explained. AC 7259. NJHD 107:4.
The second class of those who are saved. Signified.
As there are two classes of the spiritual; those who are more in good, and those who are more in truth... Sheba and Dedan = those who constitute the first class.
Shem, Ham, and Japheth = those of the Church called Noah, who were distinguished as to goods and truths into three classes.
By themselves = to everyone according to classes, or according to genera and species.
The classes of Reuben () = those who are in the Knowledges of the truth of faith, among whom they are, but in a place below them.
(Various classes of good and truth. Signified.)
According to their armies = that they are to be distinguished... into classes according to the qualities of good, in order to represent Heaven...
Aromatics of the celestial class, and of the spiritual class. Explained. AC 10295.
Truths of the celestial class, and of the spiritual class. Explained.
Some numbers belong to the spiritual class, and some to the celestial class. Enumerated.
The classes of Reuben = Knowledges of every kind, which are of wisdom.
All the tribes of Israel are here distinguished into four classes... and each class contains three tribes.
The classes of Reuben = all things both true and good which are in the natural man.
